system.description:
• Effect: Whenever you choose the free route to Metamagic through Wild Surge (below) rather than paying with Spellburn, the GM rolls d20 in secret on the Corruption Table — a GM-only resource players never see. A result of 1 triggers a Major Corruption event. A result of 2-20 triggers a Minor Corruption effect — these can be cosmetic, beneficial, or detrimental.
  • The player knows something has shifted but not what the table said
  • Minor Corruption (GM only): a d20 result of 2–20.
  • Major Corruption (GM only): on a result of 1, roll a d6.

activities.name: Corruption roll
activities.text: After taking Wild Surge's free route to Metamagic: the GM's secret Corruption roll. 1: a Major Corruption (the GM rolls a d6); 2 to 20: a Minor Corruption.
